title: AWS IAM Role Trust Policy Modification
description: Detects modification of IAM role trust policies (UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, UpdateRole) which can weaken principal restrictions/conditions to allow unauthorized assumption. Adds Conditional Access Policies modification (T1556.009) coverage beyond the existing SigmaHQ SSO external-IdP change rule.
falsePositives: Legitimate role trust-policy management by administrators or IaC.
